title: Monster Mash: A Night of Classic Frights (Dance Party & Fundraiser)
description: The Northeast Ursamen open Spooky Bear a day early with a Wednesday-night dance party at the Boatslip. The $10 party pass covers admission, music and a costume contest, and ticket proceeds go to the AIDS Support Group of Cape Cod.
notes: Official poster and Zeffy list 7 PM start with no end time; Out x Out shows 7-10 PM but says the end time is unpublished.

title: Qya Cristal & The Bart Weisman Trio: Spooky Bear Live Music
description: A live jazz/vocal set from Qya Cristal with the Bart Weisman Trio, listed by the Crown & Anchor as part of its Spooky Bear programming on the Wednesday before the weekend.
notes: Only seen in the Crown's events list; price/room not confirmed.

title: Solid Gold Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: The opening tea dance of the weekend on the Boatslip's harbor deck, with resident DJ Maryalice spinning remixed '70s and '80s disco in a Studio 54 mood. Sequins, gold, bell-bottoms and big hair are encouraged.
notes: Cover charge not published; the Boatslip tea normally has a door cover. Not on the Ursamen official poster (venue-run).

title: Destroy Mona: A Drag Requiem
description: Mona Mour's drag show returns to Purgatory for a second Halloween-season night. Doors 6:30 PM, show 7 PM, 21+.
notes: Not Spooky Bear-branded; included because PBG lists it in its Spooky Bear Halloween Weekend category.

title: Carve Me Daddy: Spooky Bear Pumpkin Carving Party
description: A free pumpkin-carving party in the Crown's restaurant and courtyard with live music, food specials and cocktails. Pumpkins and carving supplies are provided while they last.
notes: Crown site says 7-9 PM; ptown.org time field says 8-10 PM.

title: Spooky Bear Early Bear Meet Up
venue: The Porch Bar at Gifford House
description: The official Thursday-night welcome gathering for early arrivals, hosted by the Northeast Ursamen at the Gifford House Porch Bar. A casual, no-ticket way to meet other attendees before the weekend's parties.

title: Wave of Terror: Spooky Bear Video Night with VJ Tom Yaz
venue: The Wave Bar at Crown & Anchor
description: A free Halloween video night in the Wave Bar, with VJ Tom Yaz mixing music videos, spooky pop favorites and campy Halloween classics on the screens.

title: FAT SLUT – Spooky Bear (hosted by Meatball)
price: $22.42 Early Slut (limited) / $27.69 Late Slut GA, fees included
description: LA drag star Meatball brings her FAT SLUT party to the Crown's Paramount room for Spooky Bear. Expect drag shows with a special guest, go-go dancers, a dance party and the party's signature food-eating competition.

title: FURBALL: Howl Underwear and Gear Party
description: Brooklyn Joe's long-running Furball underwear and gear dance party returns to the Red Room for Spooky Bear Thursday, with go-go dancers and a sweaty dance floor. Doors 9:15 PM; last year's edition sold out.
notes: End time (11:30 PM) only from Out x Out; Red Room lists none. Price not shown on Red Room page.

title: 4th Annual Townie Masquerade Ball
description: Gifford House's Halloween masquerade with live piano-bar music, autumn games and spooky activities in the yard, and a ball downstairs in Club Purgatory with DJ William Francis. Bring your best mask; free with RSVP, 21+.
notes: Sickening/Out x Out say 10 PM; ptown.org calendar lists 9 PM. End time from Out x Out.

title: HalloQueen Burner Brunch with Tina Burner (10:30 AM seating)
price: $25 ($27.69 with fees); food and drinks not included
description: Drag Race All Star Tina Burner hosts a Halloween drag brunch of live performance, comedy and camp. Doors 10:30 AM, show 11 AM; costumes encouraged. Ticket covers the show only.
notes: Listed on the official Ursamen poster (10:30 AM & 1 PM).

title: HalloQueen Burner Brunch with Tina Burner (1 PM seating)
price: $25 ($27.69 with fees); food and drinks not included
description: Second seating of Tina Burner's HalloQueen Burner Brunch, a Halloween drag brunch of live performance, comedy and camp. Ticket covers the show only; food and drinks are extra.
notes: Price assumed same as 10:30 seating ($25 per ptown.org); 1 PM tier page not fetched.

title: Loving Our Bear Bodies (Friday sessions)
description: Bear Your Soul's body-positive workshop led by Freddy and Jay Freeman, presented with the Northeast Ursamen. Two Friday sessions (11 AM–1 PM and 1:30–3:30 PM), each capped at 30 GBTQ men 18+; participants shed clothing and shame in a structured, non-sexual setting.
organizer: Bear Your Soul with Northeast Ursamen
notes: Two separate sessions; afternoon registration: https://eastonmountain.secure.retreat.guru/program/loving-our-bare-bodies-friday-afternoon-session-spooky-bear/?form=1&lang=en

title: All Hallows Tea (Gifford House x Baby Tea)
description: A Halloween-eve outdoor tea in the Gifford House yard, running from 2 PM until dusk, starring Tyler Ashley and Charlene Incarnate. Billed as one last Baby Tea of the season, timed for Spooky Bear weekend; 21+.
notes: End listed as 'dusk'; ptownie/ptown.org show 6 PM. Not an Ursamen event.

title: Halloween Uniform Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: Friday's Boatslip tea dance takes a uniform theme: camo, combat looks or dog tags, with souvenir dog tags handed out at the door. DJ Maryalice on the deck, 4 to 7 PM.
notes: ptownie lists it as 'Dog Tag Tea'. Cover not published. Image is the Boatslip's generic Dog Tag Tea graphic.

title: Ursamen Meet & Greet
venue: The Wave Bar at Crown & Anchor
description: Meet the Northeast Ursamen board and Spooky Bear organizers over drinks in the Crown's Wave Bar. An official, casual early-evening social before Friday's parties.
notes: No ticket link anywhere; presumably free but not stated.

title: Witch Perfect (Oct 30 show)
description: An all-live-singing comedy parody of Hocus Pocus starring Tina Burner, Scarlet Envy and Alexis Michelle as the three witches, mixing pop, Disney and Broadway numbers. Doors 6:30 PM, show 7 PM.
notes: Tryst titles it 'Spooky Bear' but it is a Crown production; price tiers not rendered on the ticket page.

title: SIRENS: Live Music – Spooky Bear
description: A free sapphic Halloween night of live music with Marissa, Darlene and Lily Mae in the Crown's restaurant and courtyard.

title: Tammie Brown's Halloween Spooktacular (Fri)
description: Drag Race alum Tammie Brown's annual Halloween show at the Red Room, playing the Friday of Spooky Bear weekend.
notes: ptownie also lists a Sat Oct 31, 7 PM performance. No Red Room ticket page found; check redroom.club.

title: Sanctum Paranormal Ghost Tour (Fri)
description: The official Spooky Bear schedule lists an 8–10 PM Sanctum Paranormal ghost tour on Friday and Saturday. Sanctum's Haunted History tour is a 75-minute walk through Provincetown's ghost stories, departing from 322 Commercial Street.
notes: Sanctum's site has no Spooky Bear-specific listing; price/time are the standard tour's. Verify whether it is a dedicated Spooky Bear tour.

title: Thirsty Burlington in Spooky Cher
price: Advance sold out; some tickets may be available at the door
description: Live-vocal Cher impersonator Thirsty Burlington plays one night only as Spooky Cher for Spooky Bear weekend. Doors 8:15 PM; proceeds benefit Thirsty's ongoing cancer treatment.
notes: End time per Out x Out only.

title: Mixtape: James Jackson Jr. Piano Night – Spooky Bear
description: A Halloween edition of James Jackson Jr.'s Mixtape piano night, with throwback hits, Broadway and pop sing-alongs and costumes encouraged. No cover.

title: Motherdisco – Spooky Bear: Dead Disco Prom
description: NYC's Motherdisco takes over the Crown for a Dead Disco Prom, mixing disco, house and queer nightlife favorites until 1 AM. Dressing up for the prom theme is encouraged.

title: FAG BASH: CraZySeXyGhOuL – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: Father Figure's FAG BASH party lands in the Gifford House basement for Spooky Bear weekend with DJs Prosumer, Charlene and Father Figure and a performance by Tyler Ashley. No refunds.
notes: Price read from the Eventbrite ticket widget ($25); fees may be added at checkout.

title: Belly: Spooky Bear Edition (Underwear Party)
description: Belly's Spooky Bear underwear party at the Red Room, with music, drag and a body-inclusive crowd. Doors 9:15 PM; come in your best gear or just as you are.
notes: End time per Out x Out only.

title: The Pope's Holy Halloween Spooktacular
description: Drag Race's Discord Addams makes her Provincetown debut as a campy Pope, with Kat Sass as her nun sidekick, in a full-length cabaret of live music, a costume contest and audience participation.
notes: Provincetown Magazine and ptownie list both Oct 30 and Oct 31 at 9 PM; the Pilgrim House ticket page showed only Oct 30. Not an Ursamen event (ptownie tags it 'as part of Spooky Bear').

title: Saints & Sinners Party
description: The Northeast Ursamen's official Friday-night party takes over the Boatslip: arrive heavenly, devilish or somewhere in between for a late night of dancing, bears and costumes. Tickets are $10 through the Ursamen's Zeffy page.
dressCode: Saint or sinner costumes; Roaring Twenties weekend theme
notes: Ticket is sold as the 'Friday 10pm Saints & Sinners' item on the same Zeffy page as Saturday's bingo.

title: The Vault – Spooky Bear (Fri)
description: The Crown's leather bar runs a three-night Spooky Bear weekend with DJ Chris Racine spinning for a leather-and-bears crowd. Leather, harnesses or 'something wicked' encouraged.
notes: Cover not published; repeats Oct 31 and Nov 1.

title: Bears in the Dunes with Art's Dune Tours
description: A Saturday-morning Spooky Bear group outing into the Province Lands dunes with Art's Dune Tours, listed on the official Northeast Ursamen schedule for 9:30 AM.
notes: No dedicated booking page; Art's site has no Spooky Bear listing. Book by phone 508-487-1950. 2024 edition was $33/person.

title: Spooky Bear Marketplace
description: The Ursamen's Halloween-morning marketplace at the Boatslip, with vendors, artists and bear-community makers selling gear, art and clothing.
notes: Admission not stated; historically free to browse.

title: Crown Ghouls Drag Brunch (10:30 AM seating)
description: The Crown's all-singing, all-dancing Halloween drag brunch with Delta Miles, Roxy Pops and Qya Cristal. Doors 10:30 AM, show 11 AM; costumes encouraged, and the ticket does not include food or drinks.

title: Crown Ghouls Drag Brunch (1 PM seating)
description: Second seating of the Crown Ghouls Halloween drag brunch with Delta Miles, Roxy Pops and Qya Cristal. Ticket covers the show; food and drinks are extra.
notes: Price assumed same as the 10:30 seating.

title: Loving Our Bear Bodies (Saturday sessions)
description: Saturday sessions (11 AM–1 PM and 1:30–3:30 PM) of Bear Your Soul's body-positive workshop with Freddy and Jay Freeman, presented with the Northeast Ursamen. Capped at 30 GBTQ men 18+ per session; not a sex party.
organizer: Bear Your Soul with Northeast Ursamen
notes: Afternoon registration: https://eastonmountain.secure.retreat.guru/program/loving-our-bare-bodies-saturday-afternoon-session-spooky-bear/?form=1&lang=en

title: Zombie Drag Brunch 3
description: Mackenzie hosts a zombie-themed drag brunch with Hunter Love, Scarlett Strauss and Venus, with two shows (11 AM and 1 PM), a buffet by Chef Jonathan Saiff and prizes for best zombie looks. 18+.
notes: Not Spooky Bear-branded; included as a Halloween-day option at the Prohibition Pawty venue.

title: GOLDILOXX – Spooky Bear Daytime Delight
description: NYC bear party Goldiloxx throws its first Spooky Bear event, a Halloween-afternoon daytime party in Club Purgatory with DJ Dropo and the party's color-coded cup system. 21+.
notes: Ticket price not shown on event page.

title: Spooky Bear Drag Bingo (Bingo for a Cause)
description: The Northeast Ursamen's Halloween-afternoon drag bingo in the Crown's Paramount Room, hosted by Austin, Morgana De Lux and Felicity V. Lay, with prizes and plenty of camp. Doors 1:30 PM; proceeds support the Provincetown Firehouse.
notes: Zeffy item text still says 'Time TBD | Place TBD' but the official flyer and poster confirm Sat 2–4:30 PM, Paramount Room.

title: Spooky Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend
description: The biggest tea dance of the weekend, with extended hours from 4 to 9 PM on the Boatslip's harbor deck. Full Halloween costume expected, with time built in for a costume change before the ball.
notes: Some aggregator copy says 4–7 PM; the Boatslip's own calendar confirms 4–9 PM. Cover not published.

title: The Prohibition Pawty
description: A Roaring Twenties speakeasy warm-up in the Keyhole, the hidden cabaret bar inside the Provincetown Inn, held between Spooky Tea and the Death Becomes Them costume ball. Listed on the official Ursamen schedule.
notes: No ticket or reservation link anywhere; Keyhole's general reserved seating runs $20 floor / $30 VIP via sickening.events but shows no Oct 31 date. Keyhole seating is limited.

title: Dark Rooms: Jackie Cox (Halloween adults-only cabaret)
description: Jackie Cox's adults-only Halloween cabaret, loosely inspired by the Backrooms horror film, with live vocals, comedy and costumes. Doors 6:45 PM; her third Spooky Bear engagement at the Red Room.
notes: ptownie lists 8 PM; Red Room says doors 6:45/show 7 PM.

title: Witch Perfect (Oct 31 show)
description: Halloween-night performance of the all-live-singing Hocus Pocus parody with Tina Burner, Scarlet Envy and Alexis Michelle. Doors 6:30 PM, show 7 PM.

title: Tammie Brown's Halloween Spooktacular (Sat)
description: Second night of Tammie Brown's annual Halloween show at the Red Room.
notes: Only ptownie lists the Saturday date; Out x Out lists Friday only. Verify with redroom.club.

title: Drop Dead to the Grave: Live Music – Spooky Bear
description: A free Halloween-night live-music cabaret hosted by Jarvis Derrell, featuring Alexander Zenoz, the Birds of Paradise and guests with a live band. Dress up and grab a cocktail before the ball.
notes: ptown.org lists 8–9 PM; Crown page says 8–10 PM.

title: Sanctum Paranormal Ghost Tour (Sat)
description: Halloween-night edition of the ghost tour listed on the official Spooky Bear schedule, 8–10 PM. Sanctum's Haunted History walk covers Provincetown's history and paranormal lore and departs from 322 Commercial Street.
notes: Same caveat as Friday: no Spooky Bear-specific listing on Sanctum's site.

title: Death Becomes Them: A Roaring Twenties Halloween Costume Ball
description: The weekend's marquee event: a Roaring Twenties Halloween costume ball at the Crown with performances by Jan Sport and Tina Burner, music by DJ Jake Glass and VJ Tom Yaz, and a costume contest with a $500 grand prize. Come glamorous, ghoulish or dressed to kill.
notes: ptown.org lists $25 and 9–11:55 PM; Tryst tiers are $22.42/$27.69 with fees. ptownie also names Jackie Cox as a headliner; official flyer lists only Jan Sport and Tina Burner.

title: The Underwear Party: Spooky Bear 26 Edition
description: Provincetown's original underwear party gets a Spooky Bear Halloween-night edition in Club Purgatory with DJs Sindri, Father Figure and William Francis. Clothes check available; 21+.
notes: Event title on Sickening is misspelled 'SOOKY BEAR'.

title: Possessed 7 Halloween Blowout
description: Red Room's seventh annual Halloween party opens all three clubs as the Graveyard, the Catacombs and the Cornfield Drag Barn, plus a new VIP balcony, with DJs, pop-up ghouls and a $1,000 best-costume cash prize. Hosted by Tammie Brown and Jackie Cox; doors 9:45 PM.
notes: Not Spooky Bear-branded; included as the main non-Ursamen Halloween-night party. Typically sells out.

title: The Vault – Spooky Bear (Sat)
description: Halloween night in the Crown's leather bar with DJ Chris Racine; leather, harnesses or something wicked encouraged.

title: Tryster Act: Brunch of the Dead (10:30 AM seating)
price: $25 ($27.69 with fees); $25 minimum spend, food not included
description: The closing Sunday drag brunch with Drag Race All Stars Jan Sport, Tina Burner and Jackie Cox plus Jarvis Derrell, with live vocals, comedy and sing-alongs and an all-you-care-to-eat buffet available. Doors 10:30 AM, show 11 AM.
notes: Out x Out's generic copy says 'drag brunch noon–3 PM'; the Crown's actual seatings are 10:30 AM and 1 PM.

title: Tryster Act: Brunch of the Dead (1 PM seating)
price: $25 ($27.69 with fees); $25 minimum spend, food not included
description: Second seating of the Sunday Tryster Act drag brunch with Jan Sport, Tina Burner, Jackie Cox and Jarvis Derrell. Ticket covers the show; buffet and drinks are extra.
notes: Price assumed same as the 10:30 seating.

title: Solid Gold Tea – Spooky Bear Weekend Closer
description: The Sunday send-off tea on the Boatslip deck, with DJ Maryalice's remixed '70s and '80s disco. Dress code is sequins, satin and gold.
notes: Note the Boston fast ferry's last Sunday sailing (3 PM) leaves before this tea; no ferry Mon Nov 2 (per gaytravel4u).

title: The Vault – Spooky Bear (Sun)
description: Final night of the Crown leather bar's three-night Spooky Bear run with DJ Chris Racine.
